about: Lithicarb and Natrilix SR identify overlapping lithium and indapamide supplies from brand names alone.
The lithium supply covers the new furosemide course after 90 observable diuretic-free days, and the day-six level belongs in the same interaction review.
The indapamide starts 61 days after a 50-day lithium supply, outside both the exposure and the 60-day window.
